notes: Hardcoded C string constants (Phase 8 Text Surface Inventory §5), not DDX resource data -- no source_ddx/node_id/tokens fields apply. Exists so tools/font/build_font.py --from-translations picks up the glyphs these strings need, and so translations are tracked/reviewable the same way as DDX entries. Each id names the exact C source array/variable + index it patches.

Currency unit word, shared across gstate_format_money's 3 display modes and INVENTOR.C's own inline copy; matches OBJINFO.DAT#53 "Gold Sovereigns" -> 金幣. The English source used two inconsistent word choices ("gold"/"sovereign") for the same currency depending on mode -- unified to one Chinese term.

Currency unit word; matches OBJINFO.DAT#54 "Silver Royals" -> 銀盾 (established via the DIAL_Z18 exchange-rate line "十枚銀盾能兌一枚金幣"). Also unifies the English "silver"/"royal" split into one term. The English plural-suffix logic (strcat "s", %c 's') was dropped since Chinese nouns don't inflect for number -- verified the branches produced byte-identical output either way before removing them.
Travel-cost display on the fast-travel map screen; same currency as GSTATE.C's gold/sovereign.
